description: This file defines the AlarmDataSubscription class, which manages subscriptions to alarm data streams, including handling data updates, page data, and interaction with telemetry services within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AlarmSubscriptionDataKey
classes.description: Interface representing a data key with a name and type for alarm subscriptions.

classes.name: AlarmDataSubscriptionOptions
classes.description: Interface defining options for alarm data subscriptions, including data keys, filters, and time windows.

classes.name: AlarmDataSubscription
classes.description: Class managing alarm data subscriptions, handling data retrieval, updates, and interaction with telemetry services.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the alarm data stream if the data source type is entity.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Sets up the subscription to alarm data, configuring filters, commands, and handling incoming data updates.

methods.name: resetData
methods.description: Resets internal data index mappings based on current page data.

methods.name: onPageData
methods.description: Handles new page data, updates internal state, and notifies listener.

methods.name: onDataUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to existing alarm data entries and notifies listener.
